verdict: Numbers not to be trusted: the game's left and right hand sits metres from its controller, so the two were logged in different spaces (world and room); every gap, wander and jump below is off by the player's walking. mag: 1 of 1 finished; the game's left hand trails the controller by 12 frames (187.9 ms); the game's left hand wanders up to 15651.6 cm from its usual place; the game's right hand trails the controller by 12 frames (187.9 ms); the game's right hand wanders up to 15694.7 cm from its usual place; the game's hand jumped 823 times while the controller was calm; a controller jumped 6 times (tracking glitches); tracking lost 2 times, 1 with the hands stacked (occlusion).
